title: Oven-Baked Norwegian Salmon Gratin
description: A malty and juicy Norwegian salmon gratin that feels romantic and Mediterranean-friendly, topped with creamy gorgonzola-dolce and a fragrant tadka.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C) and lightly oil a slate tile baking dish.
Place salmon fillets skin-side down in the dish and season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, and dried dill.
In a small saucepan, heat olive oil and butter over medium heat until butter foams, then whisk in heavy cream and gorgonzola-dolce until smooth.
Pour the creamy sauce evenly over the salmon fillets.
Sprinkle toasted sliced almonds on top of the sauce.
Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes or until salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove from oven, garnish with chopped chives, and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve immediately with a side of steamed vegetables or a fresh salad.
